_what: Web pages a person saved as clips, kept in their Trillion files and read by src/saved-pages.mjs. Each saved page is one JSON file under `folder` (its address, title, the page's text, where its snapshot picture is kept, its refresh policy and when it was last refreshed) and one row in the index file, so a refresh can find what is due without reading every page. The page is read by the Workshop tool named in `capture`: `fields` say where in its answer the title, the text and (when the tool can draw one) the snapshot picture are; a tool that gives no picture saves the page without one and says so.

words.no_url: Give url: the http or https address of the page to save.
words.bad_url: {url} is not an http or https address, so it was not saved.
words.no_page: There is no saved page {asked}. Save it first with save_page.
words.no_text: The page {url} gave back no text, so nothing was saved.
words.bad_hours: refresh_every_hours must be a whole number from {min} to {max}, or null for no refresh.
words.no_snapshot: The tool that read this page draws no snapshot picture, so it was saved with its title and text only.

source.from: Spatial's CanvasWebClipItem: url, pageTitle, pageText, refreshDate, schedule, imageData (REA finding F-0416)
